sourceBuiltConfigurations.content:
# reusable ESM — host-visible names stay
[javascript]
priority = "size-first"
# 8.90: level 12 -> 15, measured -17 Brotli on this port's own
# artifact. Swept across the fleet the level is nearly inert (-160 over 22,
# and katexlil and react-markdownlil do not move at all), so it lands per
# port where it pays rather than as a default.
optimization_level = 15

cost_model = "brotli"
assume_pristine_builtins = true
strip_console = true
local_name_reserve = 48
candidate_search = "off"
function_spelling = "arrow"
public_aggregate_abi = "named"

[mangle]
identifiers = true
properties = true
exports = false
extern_fields = true
pool_strings = true

# closed LilScript world — extern class keys may mangle
[javascript]
priority = "size-first"
optimization_level = 12
cost_model = "brotli"
assume_pristine_builtins = true
strip_console = true
local_name_reserve = 48
candidate_search = "off"
function_spelling = "arrow"
public_aggregate_abi = "named"

[mangle]
identifiers = true
properties = true
exports = false
extern_fields = false
pool_strings = true

limitations: Supplementary public-binding observation, not a replacement for original tests.
The original suite passes despite differing function names on the legacy compiler's delivered artifacts.
The ESM profile explicitly requests arrow spelling; constructibility differences therefore need boundary-contract review, not silent equivalence credit.
Upstream dependency closure is not pinned by this diagnostic; no competitive eligibility or size win follows.
CJS, UMD, installed-package, declaration and browser consumers remain required work.
